summaries.name: Windows Battery Report
summaries.summary: Windows Battery Report is a built-in Windows 10 tool (accessed by searching "battery report" in the Start menu) that generates a detailed report on a laptop battery's health, including capacity, usage patterns, and estimated battery life.

summaries.name: Coconut Battery
summaries.summary: Coconut Battery is a free Mac app providing detailed information on a MacBook's battery, including capacity, cycle count, and health.

summaries.name: BatteryMon
summaries.summary: BatteryMon is a free Windows tool that displays detailed information about a laptop's battery, including capacity, voltage, and temperature.

summaries.name: HWiNFO
summaries.summary: HWiNFO is a free Windows system monitoring tool that includes a battery health check feature.

summaries.name: Netflix
summaries.summary: The user streams movies on Netflix and noticed improved streaming quality after upgrading their internet speed to 500 Mbps about three weeks prior to 2023-05-25.

summaries.name: Google Chrome
summaries.summary: Google Chrome is recommended as a battery-saving browser due to its built-in power-saving features.
